name: Manitoba rent increase guideline 2026
description: Annual guideline of 1.8% for 2026 for most residential units, effective 1 January 2026; three months' written notice.

attributes.exempt: units renting at or above the threshold ($1,670/month in the 2026 release), social housing, government-owned units, buildings first occupied after March 2005, co-ops and life-lease units
attributes.notice: at least three months' written notice

sources.title: Manitoba sets 2026 rent increase guideline (release of 29 August 2025)
sources.licence: Government of Manitoba website terms (link and cite)

limitations: Secondary reports say an October 2026 regulation raised the exemption threshold to $2,000 and cut above-guideline increases; the 2027 guideline was not found. Re-check.
